faq.title: FAQ
faq.intro: Quick answers about Geeklogs. For account or billing help, contact support.
faq.q1Body: A single place to log movies, TV, games, board games, books, anime, manga, and comics—with grades, reviews, and stats.
faq.q2Body: Some catalogs (e.g. TMDB, RAWG, BGG) work best with your own free API keys. Add them in Settings, or use server defaults when available. Admins can relax key requirements for everyone via feature flags.
faq.q3Title: What is the difference between Free, Beta, and Pro?
faq.q3Body: Free has a log limit and core features. Beta usually includes Pro-style features with the same log cap as Free. Pro removes the log limit and includes full access. See Plans for current details.
faq.q4Title: How do I export my data?
faq.q4Body: Pro (and Beta where enabled) can export logs from category views and Settings. Exports are generated from your account data on the server.
faq.q5Title: How do I delete my account?
faq.q5Body: Contact {{email}} with your registered email address. We will verify ownership and process deletion according to our retention policy.

legal.privacyIntro:
Geeklogs ("we") processes personal data you provide when you create an account and use the service (e.g. email, username, logs, reviews, and settings). We use this data to run the product, secure accounts, and process subscriptions when you upgrade to Pro.

This summary is not legal advice. Have qualified counsel review before launch in regulated markets.
legal.privacyData: Data may be stored with our hosting and database providers (e.g. Vercel, Render, Supabase, or equivalents you configure). We do not sell your personal data. Aggregated or de-identified analytics may be used to improve reliability and usage.
legal.privacyRights: Depending on your region, you may have rights to access, correct, export, or delete personal data. Contact us to exercise those rights.
legal.termsIntro: By using Geeklogs you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service. We may update these terms; continued use after changes means you accept the new terms.
legal.termsAcceptable: You agree not to abuse the service (e.g. scraping at scale, attacking infrastructure, or violating others' rights). We may suspend accounts that harm the platform or other users.
legal.termsThirdParty: Content and metadata come from third-party APIs (TMDB, RAWG, BGG, etc.). Those services have their own terms; we are not responsible for third-party availability or accuracy.
legal.termsSubscription: Pro subscriptions are billed through Stripe. Cancellations and refunds follow Stripe and the options shown in the billing portal. Pricing may differ by region (e.g. Brazil vs default).

apiKeyTutorial.tmdb:
1. Go to themoviedb.org and create a free account or log in.
2. Open Settings → API from the left menu (or go to the link below).
3. Click "Request an API Key" and choose "Developer".
4. Accept the terms and fill the form (Application URL: your site or http://localhost:5173, Application Summary: e.g. "Personal media log").
5. On the API page, copy the "API Key (v3 auth)" and paste it below.
apiKeyTutorial.rawg:
1. Go to rawg.io and sign up or log in.
2. Open the API docs link below and look for "Get your API key" or the signup form.
3. Register for an API key (free tier available).
4. Copy the key from your account/dashboard and paste it below.
apiKeyTutorial.bgg:
1. Go to boardgamegeek.com and log in (or create an account).
2. Open the Applications link below.
3. Click to create a new application (e.g. "Geeklogs").
4. Choose non-commercial if it's for personal use; submit and wait for approval (can take a few days).
5. Once approved, open your application and create a Token.
6. Copy the Bearer token and paste it below.
apiKeyTutorial.ludopedia:
1. Create an account at https://ludopedia.com.br/novousuario or log in at ludopedia.com.br.
2. Open Aplicativos (https://www.ludopedia.com.br/aplicativos) and create an application.
3. Use Ludopedia's OAuth flow to obtain an access token (see API documentation). The key required for Ominilog is the Access Token (ACCESS_TOKEN).
4. The token is valid for 60 days; paste it below.
apiKeyTutorial.comicvine:
1. Go to comicvine.gamespot.com and create a free account or log in.
2. Open the API documentation link below.
3. Request an API key (free) from the Comic Vine API page.
4. Copy your API key and paste it below.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.betaModalMessage:
Thank you for being a beta tester—you're among the first people using Geeklogs, and your activity and feedback genuinely help us improve the product.

As a thank-you, your beta account gets full access to every Pro feature at no cost, forever. You won't need a subscription for those perks while you're on the beta tier.

We're still moving fast: things may change and you might hit the occasional rough edge. If you spot a bug or have a suggestion, we'd love to hear from you. Enjoy logging everything—and thanks again for being here early.

batchEntry.fileHint: CSV or XLSX, max 100 rows and 1MB. Must have a Name column; optional Status, Review and Rate (0–10) columns.
batchEntry.exampleFormatIntro: Your file must have a header row. The first column must be Name (or Title). You can use Status, Review and Rate (0–10) for optional status, review text and grade. Column names are case-insensitive; common aliases like "Review/comment" or "Grade/rate" work. Status must match one of the allowed values for the selected category.
batchEntry.exampleFormatNote: In CSV, separate columns with commas. In Excel, one row per item. We match each name to the selected category (e.g. Movies) and add the first search result.

about.title: About
about.projectBody: Geeklogs is like Stremio for your logs: an aggregator of APIs so you can have everything in one place. Instead of eight separate apps, use one to track movies, TV shows, board games, video games, books, anime, manga, and comics in one place. Search by category, add custom entries when something isn't in the database, and keep your reviews and grades together. No need to jump between different apps or spreadsheets—everything you watch, play, and read lives here.
about.projectHostingNote: The app currently runs on free servers and a free domain. Requests may sometimes take a while.
about.donationIntro: If Geeklogs is useful to you, you can support its development with a one-time donation or recurring support. Thank you!
about.donationNotConfigured: Donation links are not configured. Set VITE_DONATION_KOFI_URL and/or VITE_DONATION_GITHUB_SPONSORS_URL in your deployment environment to show them here.
about.donatePixIntro: Support via Pix: scan the QR code with your banking app.

coldStart.error: Geeklogs couldn’t finish loading. Check that you’re online, then tap Try again. If you haven’t opened the app in a while, it may need a little extra time the first time.
coldStart.serverSleepingHint: If nobody has used Geeklogs for a while, the first load can take up to a minute. We’re still trying in the background—you can also tap Try again whenever you like.
coldStart.timedOut: We’ve waited as long as we can and Geeklogs still isn’t responding. Check your internet connection and tap Try again. If you use a free hosting plan, waking the app up can take a full minute.
coldStart.code_TIMEOUT: Geeklogs is taking much longer than usual to answer—this often happens right after it hasn’t been used for a while. Check Wi‑Fi or mobile data, wait a bit, then tap Try again.
coldStart.code_NETWORK: We couldn’t reach Geeklogs. Make sure you’re connected to the internet, then try again.
coldStart.code_SERVER_ERROR: Geeklogs ran into a problem while working on your request. Please try again in a few minutes.
coldStart.code_UNAUTHORIZED: Your sign-in has expired or isn’t valid anymore. Sign in again to keep using your lists and reviews.
coldStart.code_FORBIDDEN: You don’t have access to that. If that surprises you, sign out and sign back in, or contact support.
coldStart.code_NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find what you were looking for. It may have been removed, or the link might be old.
coldStart.code_CLIENT_ERROR: We couldn’t make sense of that action. Double-check what you entered and try again.
coldStart.code_VERSION_MISMATCH: This version of Geeklogs is too old. Update it from the App Store, Play Store, or wherever you installed it, then open the app again.
coldStart.code_UNKNOWN: Something unexpected went wrong while loading. Tap Try again. If it keeps happening, close the app completely and open it again, or install the latest update.
